title: Beijing Eyes Military Drills in Response to Taiwan's Diplomatic Moves
description: China is expected to initiate military drills near Taiwan, using Taiwanese President Lai Ching-te's Pacific trip as a pretext. Lai's agenda involves transit through the U.S., which incurs China's disapproval. Past similar visits have triggered military actions. Beijing views Taiwan as its territory, opposing Lai's perceived separatist stance.

title: China expected to launch military drills near Taiwan over President Lai's Pacific visit
description: China is expected to conduct military drills near Taiwan during President Lai Ching-te’s Pacific visit and US transit, escalating tensions over sovereignty and regional influence

title: Why Is China Purging Some of Its Most Senior Military Leaders?
description: Chinese President Xi Jinping has devoted billions of dollars to transforming the military into a modern force by 2027. His government has also launched sweeping purges in the upper echelons of the People’s Liberation Army (PLA) in response to what US intelligence believes to be widespread corruption undermining Xi’s ambitions.

title: Corruption Cloud: Investigation Looms Over China's Defence Minister Dong Jun
description: China's Defence Minister Dong Jun is under investigation in a broad anti-corruption probe affecting China's People's Liberation Army (PLA). Previous defence ministers faced similar allegations. The moves reflect ongoing efforts to address corruption within the PLA, affecting the military and its leadership dynamics.

title: China could launch military drills near Taiwan over president's Pacific visit, sources say
description: Taiwan President Lai's Pacific trip could trigger China to launch military drills, escalating tensions as Beijing views his US transit as a provocative act

title: Tensions Rise as China Plans Military Drills Near Taiwan Amid Lai's Pacific Trip
description: China is expected to conduct military drills near Taiwan, using President Lai Ching-te's Pacific tour as a pretext. Lai's sensitive trip involves stops in Hawaii and Guam. China's military activities aim to reinforce its sphere of influence, coinciding with the U.S. presidential transition.

title: Controversial Ties: Bo Xilai's Son Marries Taiwanese Amid Political Tensions
description: China refrained from commenting on the marriage of Bo Xilai's son to a Taiwanese person, amid tense China-Taiwan relations. The marriage is a delicate subject due to Bo's family history and the father's downfall from power. Official comments were limited and the matter remains sensitive.

title: Escalating Tensions: China's Potential Military Drills Near Taiwan
description: China is anticipated to conduct military exercises near Taiwan, using Taiwanese President Lai Ching-te's visit to the Pacific and U.S. transit as a justification. This move follows previous military activities aimed at increasing pressure on Taipei and coincides with a transition in U.S. leadership.

title: China's Defence Minister Dong Jun Under Scrutiny in Corruption Probe
description: China's Defence Minister Dong Jun is under investigation in a broad anti-corruption probe targeting the top echelons of the People's Liberation Army. Dong, a former PLA Navy chief, follows two former defence ministers, amid a purge that has seen nine PLA generals dismissed. The scrutiny also involves allegations of bribery and betrayal within the Communist Party.

title: China Defence Minister Caught in Anti-Corruption Crackdown
description: China's Defence Minister Dong Jun is under investigation in an anti-corruption probe targeting the People's Liberation Army's highest ranks. This marks the third consecutive defence minister involved in such scrutiny. The minister declined a meeting with U.S. Secretary Lloyd Austin, citing tensions over Taiwan.
